tools.name: latest_news
tools.description:
Most recent published news from gol24.uz (Uzbek football news site), newest first. Use it for general questions ("what's new in football?", "today's transfer news", "what happened yesterday?"). For one club use club_news, for one person use person_news, for a topic or keyword use search_news.
Option

tools.name: search_news
tools.description:
Keyword search in gol24.uz news titles and summaries, newest first. Use it for topics, events or names that club_news and person_news cannot resolve ("Ballon d'Or", "Champions League draw", "national team"). For one specific club or person prefer club_news / person_news - they are more precise.
News

tools.name: club_news
tools.description:
News about one football club from gol24.uz, newest first. Use it instead of search_news whenever the question is about a specific club ("latest Real Madrid news", "Barcelona transfers"). For a player or coach use person_news; for general news use latest_news.

tools.name: news_story
tools.description:
One gol24.uz news item together with all related items of the same story (every step of a transfer saga, reactions to one match), related items newest first. Use it after latest_news, club_news, person_news or search_news returned an item and the user wants the background or follow-ups.
